constraints.statement: Preserve composition contract reference, digest, host binding, declaration source, ordered regime bindings, standards/policy/carrier/assurance context, deterministic closure contract and optimization contract when present. Distinguish owning selected host from source; hooks, visible defaults, policy hooks and templates may source a selection but cannot appear as owning hosts. Evaluation, admitted-state and consequence notation participating in a governed boundary must carry selected ref/digest or a causally linked selection reference.

constraints.statement: Transform produces candidate/evidence only, with no event, ledger, traversal or closure authority. Evaluation produces proposed findings and values only, with no direct close, write, selection, transition or emission of runtime truth. Consequence is projection, not an independent action stage mutating runtime truth. Plugin/evaluator returns before admission are proposed evidence and not event, ledger, projection, traversal or closure truth.

grounding.quote: **REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-010**: Regime-binding notation shall make non-`F_D` closure authority unrepresentable. `F_P` and `F_H` may construct, diagnose, repair, rank, supply evidence, judge, escalate, or stand absentia under ABG law, but they shall not claim closure authority.

constraints.statement: Regime notation makes non-F_D closure authority unrepresentable. F_P/F_H may construct, diagnose, repair, rank, provide evidence, judge, escalate or stand absentia under ABG law, but may not claim closure authority.

grounding.quote: **REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-012**: HoG shall remain the owner of direct GTL traversal mechanics. ABG shall remain the owner of event emission, payload admission, ledger projection, assurance fold, admitted transition, continuation, closure, correction, and replay truth. GTL compute notation may point at those surfaces but shall not write them.

**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-018**: ABG.system side effects shall appear
between plugin compute categories. A product plugin may compute and return
typed values or refs, but only ABG.system may admit them, write events, derive
ledgers, fold assurance, admit traversal transitions, replay continuation, or
close. HoG alone advances the admitted GTL traversal topology.

constraints.statement: HoG owns direct GTL traversal mechanics. ABG owns events, payload admission, ledger projection, assurance fold, admitted transitions, continuation, closure, correction and replay. Compute notation may reference but cannot write these. ABG.system effects occur between plugin compute categories: only ABG.system admits values, writes events, derives ledgers, folds assurance, admits transitions, replays continuation or closes; HoG alone advances admitted topology.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-013**: Product-specific pressure, gain meaning, and read-model interpretation shall remain product-owned projections over ABG-admitted facts. GTL compute notation shall not standardize downstream product strategy semantics.

**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-014**: Documentation, examples, and published tenant contracts that use the notation shall state that `Composition(...)` is display shorthand for selected `abg.fn_composition`, not a separate source of truth.

constraints.statement: Product-specific pressure, gain semantics and read-model interpretation remain Product-owned projections over ABG-admitted facts. GTL notation does not standardize downstream strategy. Documentation, examples and tenant contracts must describe Composition(...) as display shorthand for selected abg.fn_composition, never separate truth.

conditions: Preserve a regime-binding reference when present.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-015**: GTL compute notation shall expose compute plugin categories for `transform.C`, `evaluate.C`, and `consequence.C`. Each category shall preserve selected composition ref, digest, selection ref, regime binding ref when present, input carrier refs, output carrier refs, evidence refs, and non-authority flags proving the plugin cannot write ledgers, emit runtime events, select traversal, or close the boundary.

**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-016**: `plugin.transform.C` shall denote candidate/evidence computation, `plugin.evaluate.C` shall denote evaluation-rule computation inside the evaluation-set phase, and `plugin.consequence.C` shall denote consequence/read-model projection computation. These category names shall be used on public runtime observer and hook/action surfaces instead of the ambiguous `eval` stage name.

constraints.statement: Expose transform/evaluate/consequence plugin categories preserving composition reference/digest/selection reference, regime-binding reference when present, input/output carrier and evidence references, and non-authority flags for ledger/event/traversal/closure prohibition. Public observer and hook/action surfaces use plugin.transform.C, plugin.evaluate.C and plugin.consequence.C with their specific candidate, rule-computation and projection meanings instead of ambiguous eval.

grounding.quote: **REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-017**: `F_H` shall be represented as an external human-callout compute category when it participates in composition. The category shall require `F_H`, shall state that human work is external to ABG, and shall require response admission before any human result can affect runtime truth.

constraints.statement: An F_H composition participant is an external human-callout compute category that requires F_H, states that human work is outside ABG and requires response admission before any human result affects runtime truth.

grounding.quote: **REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-019**: The deterministic event-sourced case shall be represented as a lawful reduction of the same composition notation. A fully `F_D` graph remains a program graph over ABG admission/events/replay, not a separate API or shortcut around selected composition identity.

**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-023**: A scalar `FpEvaluationOutcome` shall be treated as a lawful one-rule reduction of `evaluate.C`, not as a second public evaluation carrier or a product-local runtime loop.

**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-024**: Any composed `.C` stage shall be representable as a stage-set phase under selected composition. Scalar `transform.C`, `evaluate.C`, and `consequence.C` plugin calls shall be one-task reductions of the stage-set law, not privileged alternate execution paths.

constraints.statement: A fully F_D graph is a lawful deterministic event-sourced reduction of the same composition identity and ABG admission/events/replay, with no separate API or shortcut. Scalar FpEvaluationOutcome is a one-rule evaluate.C reduction, not another carrier or Product loop. Every composed C stage is representable as a stage-set phase; scalar transform/evaluate/consequence calls are one-task reductions, never privileged alternate paths.

conditions: Deterministic register rules must be declared by the selection.
F_P semantic judgment applies when ambiguity remains.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-020**: `evaluate.C.F_D.register_rule[*]` shall be first-class evaluation work when declared by selected composition. Deterministic register rules may derive read-only shape, lineage, coverage, target-carrier, observed-state, and domain register facts, but their outputs remain proposed values until ABG admission.

**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-021**: `evaluate.C.F_P.semantic_judgment_rule[*]` shall evaluate over admitted transform truth plus admitted evaluation registers when ambiguity remains. F_P semantic judgment may propose disposition and residual pressure, but closure remains ABG-owned assurance fold truth.

**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-022**: Evaluation-set notation shall allow ordered and parallel rule batches only over read-only admitted facts. Replay identity shall derive from the selected composition identity, declared rule refs, batch/dependency refs, and admitted outcomes, not from wall-clock completion order.

constraints.statement: When declared, evaluate.C.F_D.register_rule[*] is first-class work deriving read-only shape, lineage, coverage, target-carrier, observed-state and domain registers whose results await ABG admission. When ambiguity remains, F_P semantic rules evaluate admitted transform truth plus admitted registers and may propose disposition/residual pressure; closure remains ABG assurance fold. Ordered or parallel rule batches operate only on read-only admitted facts. Replay identity comes from composition, declared rule references, batch/dependency references and admitted outcomes, never wall-clock completion order.

grounding.quote: **REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-026**: Consequence bind shall mean `plugin.consequence.C` plus ABG consequence admission, traversal transition, and replay continuation. `plugin.consequence.C` alone shall not be described as owning bind, traversal transition, replay, closure, or next-unit selection.

constraints.statement: Consequence bind consists of plugin.consequence.C plus ABG consequence admission, traversal transition and replay continuation. The plugin alone owns neither bind, transition, replay, closure nor next-unit selection.

grounding.quote: **REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-027**: A traversal unit shall be interpretable as a function over admitted intent-lineage truth: `traverse<A, B>(intent_lineage, context, A) -> (B, obligation_delta)`. The notation is a law over existing GTL/ABG carriers, not a new callable API. `intent_lineage` includes admitted intent refs, lineage refs, source and target carrier refs, materialization or output-allocation refs, carried obligation refs, residual pressure refs, and lawful basis refs. `obligation_delta` records how each carried obligation is realized, refined, deferred to a named downstream unit, blocked, repriced, preserved as no-close pressure, or discharged by terminal truth.

constraints.statement: The traversal atom can be interpreted as traverse<A,B>(intent_lineage, context, A) -> (B, obligation_delta), a law over existing carriers, not a callable API. Intent lineage includes admitted intent/lineage, source/target carrier, materialization/output-allocation, carried obligation, residual pressure and lawful basis references. Each carried obligation receives an explicit delta: realized, refined, deferred to a named downstream unit, blocked, repriced, preserved as no-close pressure or discharged by terminal truth.

grounding.quote: **REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION-028**: Consequence bind shall preserve intent-lineage and obligation conservation across traversal-unit composition. A close or next-unit selection is non-conformant when any carried obligation, target-carrier binding, materialization target, role requirement, staged-authority ref, or downstream terminal pressure disappears without admitted realization evidence, refinement, downstream deferral, block, re-entry, reprice, no-close preservation, or terminal projection.

constraints.statement: Preserve lineage and obligations across unit composition. Close/next-unit selection is nonconforming if a carried obligation, target binding, materialization target, role requirement, staged authority reference or downstream terminal pressure disappears without admitted realization evidence, refinement, downstream deferral, block, re-entry, reprice, no-close preservation or terminal projection.

grounding.quote:

shall identify its declared workspace subject and immutable observation basis.
Context locator/digest truth binds the observed material, not a claim that the

establish current workspace state without applicable support. A prompt-only

conditions: A supplement becomes required only when explicitly selected.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-L-GTL3-CONTEXT-008**: An STDO-governed Program shall explicitly select a
reusable GTL-declared environment and its snapshot-bound Context data. The
declaration shall identify the exact immutable STDO release and content basis,
required native source material, permitted acquisition and required access
evidence, and role-specific frame and instruction-policy references. A
supplementary representation, index or corpus-access implementation shall be
required only when explicitly selected by that environment; each selected
supplement shall preserve its exact released identity, source relationship,
access contract and required evidence. Publication, raw admission and
interpretation shall preserve these relations. A mutable selector, ambient
install, available tool, source-development composition or instruction text
shall not substitute for the declaration. Programs that do not adopt this
environment shall not acquire an STDO requirement implicitly. Environment
declaration truth grants neither access permission nor runtime admission;
optional selection shall not make required declared content or access evidence
optional.

constraints.statement: An STDO-governed Program explicitly selects reusable GTL environment and snapshot Context with exact immutable release/content basis, native material, acquisition permission and required access evidence, and role-specific frame/instruction policy references. Supplements are required only if explicitly selected and must preserve exact released identity, source relationship, access contract and required evidence. Publication/raw admission/interpretation conserve those relations. Mutable selectors, ambient installs, available tools, source-development composition and instruction prose do not substitute. Declaration grants neither access nor runtime admission; optional environment selection does not make its required contents/evidence optional.

grounding.quote:

evaluation/work contract through existing Context, contract and policy
declarations selected by its graph composition. The binding shall preserve the
owning frame definition, exact subject/basis, required observations, criteria,
authority, evidence, result relation and invalidation conditions. A rendered
prompt shall remain a projection of that binding. A role name, overlay row or
runtime Frame identity alone shall not establish it.

constraints.statement: A framed call binds its reusable contract explicitly through graph-selected Context/contract/policy declarations and preserves every listed element. Rendered prompt is projection only; role name, overlay row or runtime Frame identity alone is insufficient.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-L-GTL3-CONTEXT-010**: Frame selection shall be declared or follow a prior
admitted selection under Program policy. Acquisition of missing observations
shall be declared work. Unknown applicability, missing required evidence,
out-of-frame material and invalid basis shall remain explicit dispositions;
context assembly shall not infer an evaluation pass or silently omit an
applicable required evaluation.

constraints.statement: Frame selection is declared or follows prior admitted selection under Program policy. Missing-observation acquisition is declared work. Unknown applicability, missing required evidence, out-of-frame material and invalid basis remain explicit dispositions; assembly cannot infer pass or silently omit an applicable required evaluation.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-L-GTL3-CONTEXT-011**: Multiple frames shall preserve their separate
definitions, evidence and authority. Any relied-upon refinement, translation,
conjunction or dependency shall be explicit. Graph nesting shall not establish
frame hierarchy, authority precedence or evaluation sufficiency by itself.

**REQ-L-GTL3-CONTEXT-012**: A material frame, subject or observation change
shall invalidate dependent evaluation support before reuse while preserving
unaffected support. Selection shall use sufficient bounded material and current
admitted projections under the Product reuse law; a role handoff alone shall
not require full-history reconstruction or full-workspace scanning.

constraints.statement: Separate frames keep separate definitions, evidence and authority. Relied-on refinement, translation, conjunction and dependency are explicit; graph nesting alone gives no hierarchy, precedence or sufficiency. Material frame/subject/observation changes invalidate dependent support before reuse while preserving unaffected support. Select sufficient bounded material and current admitted projections under Product reuse law; a role handoff alone does not require full-history reconstruction or workspace scans.
